name: single-binary
body: Delivered as one self-contained static `eypres` binary (Go) per supported target: darwin/arm64 and windows/amd64 (required), plus windows/arm64 only when its GitHub-hosted native runner is available (see supported-platforms). No Intel macOS and no Linux. No runtime, network access or install step needed beyond placing the binary (Homebrew/Scoop channels are a convenience). The binary packages the whole tool (authoring/scaffolding, templating, validation, presentation). AC: for every release, the offline init/start e2e passes on a native GitHub Actions runner for each supported target (see native-ci-verification); cross-compiling alone does not satisfy this AC.
